archive_rebinding_scope: Only source catalog/split/import and preceding review references rebound to byte-identical preserved inputs. Original review retained; no decisions changed.

families.rationale: App Reporting packages explicitly depend on Fivetran Apple Store and Google Play. App version/OS versus overview objectives differ; the lower-level country/device/overview tasks reuse component projects. Conservatively keep this package dependency family together without claiming equal outputs or identical input data.
Same QuickBooks project and shared double-entry/transaction components. General-ledger union versus enriched bill/invoice reporting are different objectives within one project.

Same Recharge project; both initial SQL files from 001 are also present unchanged in 002. Charge-line-item construction and customer transaction rollups use overlapping components, with different requested grain.

The first two tasks have the same initialized SQL file set and different product/shop versus discount-code goals. Holistic Reporting explicitly depends on Fivetran Shopify and combines it with Klaviyo; group the package relationship conservatively, without claiming an identical warehouse or answer.
Same Redshift-demo/TICKIT project, with 15 shared initialized SQL contents. Sales buyer/seller summaries and event/listing enrichment are different objectives within that project.

Same TPC-H project with four shared initialized SQL contents. Customer lifetime/return calculations and low-cost UK brass supplier selection are different objectives; the shared project is the grouping rationale.
Same Workday project with 56 shared initialized SQL contents. Organization-role/worker positions and job-profile/family reporting are different output models within that project.

All identify Xero 0.6.2. Calendar-spine and invoice-line-item SQL are identical across all three initialized projects. Monthly balance-sheet objectives overlap, and the three-report request includes a balance sheet. Different profiles, package presence and removed models remain recorded, not treated as identical initialization.

Prompts have the same genre/title/premiere/renewal objective with only the product name changed, but initialized projects are MovieLens versus Netflix programming. Retain a conservative same-split prompt-reuse group; this does not assert a shared project or fix the separately evidenced movie_recomm task mismatch.
User sign-up/page-visit aggregation using after versus all-ever methods; dbt activity-schema project.
Malaysian airport arrival aggregation and airport distances; Malaysia airport project.
Asana team/user task completion and close-time metrics; Asana project.
Daily stock bid/ask/mid prices and book value; asset project.
ATP tournament/player match-statistic enrichment; ATP project.
Actor movie ratings and releases by year; Flicks project, distinct from Netflix programming and MovieLens.
Enhanced recruiting jobs/applications; Greenhouse project, distinct from Lever source/configuration.
COVID country/date cases/deaths with country-code join; Hive demonstration project.
Contact email/engagement and email campaign metrics; HubSpot project, distinct from Marketo sources.
Monthly electricity peak with 12-month average and change; Inzight project.
Project leads/epics/components and issue closure metrics; Jira project.
Job postings/applications/interviews/requisitions/hiring managers; Lever project.
Latest email templates and delivery/interaction metrics; Marketo project.
Doctor and patient dimensional information; claim_to_fame project, distinct from NPPES mapping and Synthea event costing.
NBA regular season/playoff/Elo summaries; sports_sims project.
Daily guide/page metrics; Pendo project.
Generic completion request on acme/playbook project. Output intent is under-specified; no semantic certification inferred from family assignment.
Medicare/NUCC taxonomy and NPI provider enrichment; NPPES project.
Directory contacts, recent additions and survey engagement; Qualtrics project.
Paranormal post/comment relations and metadata; Reddit project.
SAP general-ledger extraction/aggregation for 0fi_gl_10 and 0fi_gl_14; distinct SAP project.
Corporate-email account activity/order summaries; dbt_scd project.
Combined Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn/Twitter reports; social_media_reporting project.
Healthcare-event cost/charge/payment aggregation; synthea_omop_etl project.
Phone/account messaging counts/status/spend; Twilio project.
Daily and overall account reporting; Zuora project.

limitations: This is a family/split review, not verifier validation or proof of task solvability.
Project/package relations can justify conservative grouping without proving equal data or answers.
No unmatched exact SQL content was observed in the 71 inspected public project trees; differing text can still implement related logic.
All inspected ADE/Spider tasks are historical train. No unseen-project/warehouse or clean checkpoint holdout claim.
DEB semantic family and cross-split exposure review remains unfinished.
